Interface AsyncDiscoveryClient

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultCompositeDiscoveryClient
public interface AsyncDiscoveryClient
The CompletionStage counterpart of a DiscoveryClient. A DiscoveryClient that can look up the services without a publisher also implements this interface, and the framework then calls these methods instead of the publisher methods.

An implementation returns a new stage for each call, which a caller may cancel. The framework never cancels a stage it did not create: it ignores its result instead.
